
	<h1 class="postTitle"><a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/sonnyBag/p/19096191" title="发布于 2025-09-17 09:46">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Oracle 19c asm单机OPatch补丁报错"checkSystemCommandAvailable" failed.</span>
    

</a>
</h1>
	<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>　　一、OPatch Conflict Check</p>
<p>As the Grid home user:</p>
<pre class="oac_no_warn">% $ORACLE_HOME/OPatch/opatch prereq CheckConflictAgainstOHWithDetail -phBaseDir &lt;UNZIPPED_PATCH_LOCATION&gt;/36916690/36912597<br>
% $ORACLE_HOME/OPatch/opatch prereq CheckConflictAgainstOHWithDetail -phBaseDir &lt;UNZIPPED_PATCH_LOCATION&gt;/36916690/36917416<br>
% $ORACLE_HOME/OPatch/opatch prereq CheckConflictAgainstOHWithDetail -phBaseDir &lt;UNZIPPED_PATCH_LOCATION&gt;/36916690/36917397<br>
% $ORACLE_HOME/OPatch/opatch prereq CheckConflictAgainstOHWithDetail -phBaseDir &lt;UNZIPPED_PATCH_LOCATION&gt;/36916690/36940756<br>
% $ORACLE_HOME/OPatch/opatch prereq CheckConflictAgainstOHWithDetail -phBaseDir &lt;UNZIPPED_PATCH_LOCATION&gt;/36916690/36758186</pre>
<p>For Oracle home, as home user:</p>
<pre class="oac_no_warn">% $ORACLE_HOME/OPatch/opatch prereq CheckConflictAgainstOHWithDetail -phBaseDir &lt;UNZIPPED_PATCH_LOCATION&gt;/36916690/36912597
% $ORACLE_HOME/OPatch/opatch prereq CheckConflictAgainstOHWithDetail -phBaseDir &lt;UNZIPPED_PATCH_LOCATION&gt;/36916690/36917416<br><br>二、OPatch System Space Check</pre>
<ol>
<li>
<ul>
<li>
<p>For Grid Infrastructure home, as home user:</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p>Create file&nbsp;<code class="codeph">/tmp/patch_list_gihome.txt</code>&nbsp;with the following content:</p>
<pre class="oac_no_warn">% cat /tmp/patch_list_gihome.txt

&lt;UNZIPPED_PATCH_LOCATION&gt;/36916690/36912597
&lt;UNZIPPED_PATCH_LOCATION&gt;/36916690/36917416
&lt;UNZIPPED_PATCH_LOCATION&gt;/36916690/36917397
&lt;UNZIPPED_PATCH_LOCATION&gt;/36916690/36940756
&lt;UNZIPPED_PATCH_LOCATION&gt;/36916690/36758186
</pre>
&lt;class="infoboxnote"&gt;
<p class="notep1">Note:</p>
<p>For HP-UX Itanium and Linux on IBM System z platforms, the last two rows in the previous example should not be added to the&nbsp;<code class="codeph">patch_list_gihome.txt</code>&nbsp;file.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Run the OPatch command to check if enough free space is available in the Grid Infrastructure home:</p>
<pre class="oac_no_warn">% $ORACLE_HOME/OPatch/opatch prereq CheckSystemSpace -phBaseFile /tmp/patch_list_gihome.txt
</pre>
</li>
</ol></li>
<li>
<p>For Oracle home, as home user:</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p>Create file&nbsp;<code class="codeph">/tmp/patch_list_dbhome.txt</code>&nbsp;with the following content:</p>
<pre class="oac_no_warn">% cat /tmp/patch_list_dbhome.txt
&lt;UNZIPPED_PATCH_LOCATION&gt;/36916690/36912597
&lt;UNZIPPED_PATCH_LOCATION&gt;/36916690/36917416
</pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>Run OPatch command to check if enough free space is available in the Oracle home:</p>
<pre class="oac_no_warn">% $ORACLE_HOME/OPatch/opatch prereq CheckSystemSpace -phBaseFile /tmp/patch_list_dbhome.txt</pre>
</li>
</ol></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<p>　　三、As root user, execute the following command on each node of the cluster:</p>

<p>　　四、pluggable容器数据库更新</p>
<ol>
<li>Any (pluggable) database that has invalid objects after the execution of datapatch should have&nbsp;<code dir="ltr">catcon.pl</code>&nbsp;run to revalidate those objects.
<pre class="oac_no_warn">For example:
export PATH=$PATH:$ORACLE_HOME/bin
cd $ORACLE_HOME/rdbms/admin
$ORACLE_HOME/perl/bin/perl $ORACLE_HOME/rdbms/admin/catcon.pl -n 1 -e -b utlrp -d $ORACLE_HOME/rdbms/admin utlrp.sql</pre>
</li>
<li>
<h4 class="sect4"><span class="enumeration_section">&nbsp;Upgrade Oracle Recovery Manager Catalog</span></h4>
<div>
<p>If you are using the Oracle Recovery Manager, the catalog needs to be upgraded. Enter the following command to upgrade it. The&nbsp;<code dir="ltr">UPGRADE CATALOG</code>&nbsp;command must be entered twice to confirm the upgrade.</p>
<pre class="oac_no_warn">$ rman catalog username/password@alias
RMAN&gt; UPGRADE CATALOG;
RMAN&gt; UPGRADE CATALOG;
RMAN&gt; EXIT;</pre>
</div>
</li>
</ol>
<p>[oracle@JX-DB-SVR02 19c]$ export PATH=$PATH:$ORACLE_HOME/bin<br>[oracle@JX-DB-SVR02 19c]$ cd $ORACLE_HOME/rdbms/admin<br>[oracle@JX-DB-SVR02 admin]$ $ORACLE_HOME/perl/bin/perl $ORACLE_HOME/rdbms/admin/catcon.pl -n 1 -e -b utlrp -d $ORACLE_HOME/rdbms/admin utlrp.sql<br>catcon::set_log_file_base_path: ALL catcon-related output will be written to [/oracle/19c/rdbms/admin/utlrp_catcon_1061.lst]</p>
<p>catcon::set_log_file_base_path: catcon: See [/oracle/19c/rdbms/admin/utlrp*.log] files for output generated by scripts</p>
<p>catcon::set_log_file_base_path: catcon: See [/oracle/19c/rdbms/admin/utlrp_*.lst] files for spool files, if any</p>
<p>catcon.pl: completed successfully</p>
<p>[oracle@JX-DB-SVR02&nbsp;admin]$&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>#AI 介绍psmisc</p>
<div class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br paragraph-JOTKXA paragraph-element br-paragraph-space">在 CentOS 7 中，<code>psmisc</code>&nbsp;是一个包含多个实用系统工具的软件包，主要用于进程管理和系统资源查看，提供了一些方便的命令来管理和监控系统中的进程。</div>
<div class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br paragraph-JOTKXA paragraph-element br-paragraph-space"><code>psmisc</code>&nbsp;包包含的核心工具及其功能如下：</div>
<ol class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br"><ol class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br">
<li>
<div class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br paragraph-JOTKXA paragraph-element br-paragraph-space"><code>fuser</code>：<br class="container-utlnW2 wrapper-d0Cc1k undefined">用于查找正在使用指定文件、目录或端口的进程 PID（进程 ID）。<br class="container-utlnW2 wrapper-d0Cc1k undefined">例如：<code>fuser /var/log/messages</code>&nbsp;可查看正在访问&nbsp;<code>/var/log/messages</code>&nbsp;文件的进程；<code>fuser -n tcp 80</code>&nbsp;可查看占用 80 端口的进程。</div>


</li>
<li>
<div class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br paragraph-JOTKXA paragraph-element br-paragraph-space"><code>killall</code>：<br class="container-utlnW2 wrapper-d0Cc1k undefined">按进程名称终止进程（与&nbsp;<code>kill</code>&nbsp;按 PID 终止不同），支持批量结束同名进程。<br class="container-utlnW2 wrapper-d0Cc1k undefined">例如：<code>killall httpd</code>&nbsp;可终止所有名为&nbsp;<code>httpd</code>&nbsp;的进程。</div>


</li>
<li>
<div class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br paragraph-JOTKXA paragraph-element br-paragraph-space"><code>pstree</code>：<br class="container-utlnW2 wrapper-d0Cc1k undefined">以树形结构显示进程间的父子关系，直观展示系统中进程的层级结构。<br class="container-utlnW2 wrapper-d0Cc1k undefined">例如：<code>pstree -p</code>&nbsp;可显示进程树并附带每个进程的 PID。</div>


</li>
<li>
<div class="auto-hide-last-sibling-br paragraph-JOTKXA paragraph-element br-paragraph-space"><code>peekfd</code>（较少使用）：<br class="container-utlnW2 wrapper-d0Cc1k undefined">查看进程打开的文件描述符内容，用于调试进程与文件的交互</div>

</li>


</ol></ol>
</div>
